description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: tall basalt column, steaming ground vent, yellow sulfur pool, pumice rock, glowing fire crystal vein in rock, ash crater pit, rock shield slab, large black obsidian boulder, small fire thorn plant, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
